reply_text:
I didn't draft the mail to Tobias. I replied to Ilse in our DM to explain why:

- **I have no rate to put in it.** Nothing earlier in our DM mentions a Tansley Parcel 2027 rate, and no Tansley Parcel contract or order form is among the files Ilse can see. Tansley Parcel is a Central team account, run by Pree as far as I can tell. Ilse isn't in any Central channel, so I didn't look there for her, and I didn't make up a number.
- **Ilse's approval isn't enough.** A rate can only go to Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark or the account owner. Tobias isn't Tansley Parcel's owner, so sending it to him needs Anselm's or June's approval. I haven't filed an approval request yet, because there's no figure to send.

I told Ilse that if she sends me the rate, or shows me where she was given it, I'll draft the mail and ask Anselm or June to approve it. Nothing goes to Tobias before one of them says yes. Pree could also share the rate with Tobias herself, since it's her account.
